summary: Add GDPR-safe, login-optional performance tracking and monetization instrumentation: an events logging system with defined core event names, optional per-fingerprint usage limits (5 free invoices/month), and Germany-optimized upsell/paywall copy and pricing to support conversion metrics.
architectural_notes: Create database table events(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_name TEXT, country TEXT, page TEXT, device TEXT, timestamp DATETIME, metadata TEXT).
Optional database table usage_limits(fingerprint TEXT PRIMARY KEY, invoices_count INTEGER, last_reset DATETIME) for free-tier gating.
Fingerprint should be derived as hash(IP + user_agent + day) to avoid storing personal data; works without login; intended GDPR-safe.
Core event_name values must not be renamed to preserve analytics consistency.

existing_features.title: Add a frontend event logging utility that can be called from anywhere in the UI to log the Core Events exactly as named (DO NOT rename) along with country, page, device, timestamp, and metadata, and that works for both anonymous and authenticated sessions.

Implement the specified fingerprint logic on the frontend and pass only the resulting fingerprint to the backend (no raw IP/user agent storage). Fingerprint must be stable for a given user-agent+IP for the current day and rotate daily.

Instrument the exact Caffeine AI Logic Flow by logging the specified events at the corresponding user actions/system points: on app load, on country detection, on VAT calculation click, on reverse charge check, on invoice preview, on invoice download attempt/success, on AI VAT explanation click, on upgrade modal shown, on Stripe checkout click, and on payment success.

Replace the current upgrade/limit-reached messaging with the provided Germany-optimized copy translated into English, and ensure the limit-reached UI is shown when the free limit is reached (invoice download gating) per the defined flow.
Add an inline upsell section under the VAT result (in the Results step) using the provided copy translated into English, including a button that opens upgrade UI and logs upgrade_cta_shown.

Add an AI explanation paywall message (English) aligned to the provided copy so that when a non-paying user tries to access gated explanation/export functionality, the app shows the paywall copy and logs ai_explain_clicked (click) and upgrade_cta_shown (paywall shown).

Update pricing presentation to be Germany-optimized as specified (Free: 5 invoices/month, Starter: €5/month, Pro: €12/month) and add micro-trust text in English: "GDPR-compliant • No signup required • No ads".

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement events table and core event logging for key app actions (app_opened, country_detected, vat_calculated, reverse_charge_checked, invoice_previewed, invoice_downloaded, ai_explain_clicked, free_limit_reached, upgrade_cta_shown, stripe_checkout_clicked, payment_success)
Add optional usage_limits table with fingerprint-based monthly invoice counting (5 free invoices/month) and gating logic (free_limit_reached triggers upgrade screen)
Implement GDPR-safe fingerprint logic (hash(IP + user_agent + day)) to track usage without login/personal data
Add Germany-optimized limit-reached modal, inline upsell under VAT result, and AI explanation paywall copy as specified
Add Germany-optimized pricing presentation (Free 5 invoices/month, Starter €5/mo, Pro €12/mo) with micro-trust text and track conversion funnel ratios weekly

Implement an on-chain events store in the Motoko backend that matches the provided schema semantics for `events` (id, event_name, country, page, device, timestamp, metadata) and can be written without requiring user login.

Add an optional backend `usage_limits` store keyed by `fingerprint` that tracks `invoices_count` and `last_reset` (monthly reset), and provide backend methods to increment/check limits for anonymous users (works without login).

Add backend query endpoints for admins to analyze performance: list events (with optional filters) and retrieve weekly aggregated counts and the key ratios: free_limit_reached / invoice_previewed, ai_explain_clicked count, stripe_checkout_clicked / upgrade_cta_shown.
Add conditional upgrade migration support for the new persisted `events` and `usage_limits` state so existing deployed state can be upgraded without data loss.

projectName: Add GDPR-safe event tracking, fingerprint-based free limits, and monetization instrumentation
